sql_calls.sql:
WITH bills_started AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bills_paid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE till_status = 'approved'
    AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT count(*) as bills_cancelled_before_payment
FROM bills_started bs
LEFT JOIN bills_paid bp ON bs.bill_id = bp.bill_id
WHERE bp.bill_id IS NULL;

WITH bills_started AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bills_with_any_payment AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT count(*) as bills_no_payment_attempt
FROM bills_started bs
LEFT JOIN bills_with_any_payment bp ON bs.bill_id = bp.bill_id
WHERE bp.bill_id IS NULL;

WITH bills_started AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bills_approved AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE till_status = 'approved'
    AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT count(*) as bills_no_approved_payment
FROM bills_started bs
LEFT JOIN bills_approved ba ON bs.bill_id = ba.bill_id
WHERE ba.bill_id IS NULL;
